title: Why Photos of the Eiffel Tower at Night are Illegal
summary: Half as Interesting explains why the Eiffel Tower's night-time lighting is under copyright, which makes publishing photos of it at night legally problematic.
why: It is the go-to reference in copyright threads for the oddity that the tower's night view is protected.

quote.text: it is illegal to take a picture of the Eiffel Tower at night but NOT during the day
